definitions.full: H2279. chobereth חֹבֶ֫רֶת noun feminine a thing that joins or is joined , only of the curtain-pieces of the tabernacle, as joined together: — ׳הַח Exod 26:10 ; 36:17 בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת 26:4 , 10 .
